UNSAFE_className.description:
**Use at your own risk:** Custom class names for specific elements. This should only be used as a
**last resort**. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

UNSAFE_style.description:
**Use at your own risk:** Custom style for specific elements. This should only be used as a
**last resort**. Using this may result in unexpected side effects.
More information in the [Customizing components Guide](https://atlantis.getjobber.com/guides/customizing-components).

align.description: The vertical alignment of the cluster elements.

ariaAttributes.description: Standard HTML aria attributes. Accepts all standard HTML aria attributes.

as.description: The HTML tag to render the cluster as.

autoWidth.description: Enabling this prevents the cluster from taking 100% of the width of the parent and instead flows with the content.

collapseBelow.description: The breakpoint below which the cluster will collapse.

collapsed.description: Force the cluster to collapse. Use this when our breakpoints are not enough control.

dataAttributes.description: Standard HTML data attributes. Accepts anything in a {{"data-key":"value"}} format.

gap.description: The amount of space between the cluster elements. Semantic tokens are available.

justify.description: The horizontal justification of the cluster elements.
